message.content: {"drafts":[{"title":"Seeking GUIs Like Perchance for Long-Form Story Writing with Local LLMs (20,000+ Words)","body":"I'm interested in tools that support writing long, coherent stories (20,000+ words) using local LLMs such as Ollama. The functionality I'm looking for resembles Perchance's story generator, which lets you write the next passage, generates subsequent text, and provides summaries of earlier parts to manage context within the model's window. Has anyone encountered GUIs or workflows that integrate with local LLMs and offer similar features for creative writing? Additionally, how do these tools handle context retention and summary generation to maintain narrative coherence over extended texts? The only resource I've found so far is the GitHub \"awesome story generation\" list, and I haven't located any active Discord communities focused on AI-assisted writing. Any recommendations or insights on practical interfaces and their limitations would be appreciated.","fact_refs":["F1","F2","F3","F4","F5","F6"]}]}
